metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Windows by rukon023: desktop notifications when Claude is done, a usage status line, and a usage limit guard

plugins.name: stop-notify
plugins.description: Windows notifications when Claude finishes and waits for you, and when it is blocked on a permission prompt

plugins.name: usage-statusline
plugins.description: Two-line status line with model, context usage, 5-hour and 7-day rate limit bars with reset times, a weekly timeline, then folder and git branch

plugins.name: usage-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude when the 5-hour or weekly usage limit reaches a threshold, warns every open session, and resumes stopped work when the 5-hour window resets
